invariants.device_authority: Next.js must never invent authoritative sensor, marker, alarm, physical-ack, rolling-buffer, on-device-storage, or power-recovery results.
invariants.stage4_hosting: A Next.js-hosted page alone does not satisfy the device-hosted Stage 4 requirement; firmware must serve a judge-safe fallback page.
invariants.idempotency: eventId is unique. Re-sending the same offline batch cannot create duplicate history rows.
invariants.ordering: Catch-up records preserve original seq order; API responses/history must not silently reorder them.
invariants.history_index: Time-range search is indexed by deviceId + occurredAt.
invariants.ack_scope: Acknowledgement is scoped to alertId and first-wins; one alert can never acknowledge another.
invariants.scope: No ESP32 firmware implementation and no visual redesign in the software track.
